description: Defines the Image_Graph_Plotarea class for rendering plot areas in a graph, including axes management, element addition, coordinate updates, and rendering logic within the PEAR PHP OO Graph Rendering Utility.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Plotarea
classes.description: Represents a plot area in a graph, managing axes, elements, coordinate calculations, and rendering within the PEAR PHP Graph Utility.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Plotarea
methods.description: Constructor initializing axes and plot area direction.

methods.name: _setParent
methods.description: Sets the parent object and propagates to axes.

methods.name: setPlotBorderStyle
methods.description: Deprecated method to set plot border style.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an element to the plot area, associating it with an axis.

methods.name: _plotWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the plot area excluding padding and axes.

methods.name: _plotHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the plot area excluding padding and axes.

methods.name: _setExtrema
methods.description: Sets axis extrema based on plot data.

methods.name: _fillLeft
methods.description: Returns the left boundary of the fill area.

methods.name: _fillTop
methods.description: Returns the top boundary of the fill area.

methods.name: _fillRight
methods.description: Returns the right boundary of the fill area.

methods.name: _fillBottom
methods.description: Returns the bottom boundary of the fill area.

methods.name: _axisPointX
methods.description: Converts a value to an X pixel position using the X axis.

methods.name: _axisPointY
methods.description: Converts a value to a Y pixel position using the Y axis.

methods.name: _pointX
methods.description: Gets the pixel X position for a value, considering orientation.

methods.name: _pointY
methods.description: Gets the pixel Y position for a value, considering orientation.

methods.name: _getMinimum
methods.description: Returns the minimum value of a specified axis.

methods.name: _getMaximum
methods.description: Returns the maximum value of a specified axis.

methods.name: _labelDistance
methods.description: Returns label distance for a specified axis.

methods.name: hideAxis
methods.description: Hides specified axes.

methods.name: clearAxis
methods.description: Removes all axes from the plot area.

methods.name: getAxis
methods.description: Retrieves an axis object based on identifier.

methods.name: _updateCoords
methods.description: Recalculates element positions and axes coordinates.

methods.name: setAxisPadding
methods.description: Sets padding inside the axes for spacing.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Renders the plot area and its axes if it contains data.
